description.value:
During the pick at P1 the gripper fingers struck the locating edge of infeed
fixture PF-3. Collision detection stopped the arm and the operator pressed the
E-stop at OP-2. The part fell onto the floor guard. Nobody was inside the cell.
Times above are from the cell HMI alarm log. The cell PC event log shows the
same alarms about a minute and a half later.

location.value: Palletising cell 3, pick station P1, infeed fixture PF-3

root_cause.value:
Under investigation. The fingers closed about 4 mm lower than taught at P1.
Wrist camera images are not recorded. LEG-01 reached the cell aisle on patrol at
14:31, but its recording ends before the collision.

text.value: Cell restarted after the break; PALLET_C3 started from the HMI
Collision detection on joint 5 at pick P1; protective stop
Operator presses the E-stop at OP-2
Cell supervisor notified; cell locked out
PF-3 locating edge found bent; part 7731-B dropped

actions.value: Replace finger set with long set FS-0340 (+6.0 mm)
Remove and refit wrist camera bracket
Set TCP z 145.5 -> 151.5 mm on pendant (tool1)
Hand-eye recalibration deferred: ChArUco board out for repair

diagnosis.value: Finger pads worn; wrist camera bracket loose

message.value: external torque 41.7 Nm exceeds collision limit 35.0 Nm
